content.text:
What the builder does and why this structure works:

- **`TestCaseBuilder`** — holds the shared `Sorter<T>` and `Reporter` once; each `add(label, input)` call delegates to `SortTestCase.of` with those captured values and returns `this` for chaining; `registerAll` pushes the accumulated cases into any registry
- **`Main`** — two builders, each typed to their element type (`Integer` vs `String`), group cases that share the same sorter; `registry.register(SortTestCase.of(..., intSorter, reporter))` repeated six times is replaced by two fluent chains; the sorter and reporter appear once per group rather than once per case
- **`SortTestCase`** — unchanged; the builder is an assembly helper above it, not a replacement for its construction logic
